name: Full Kiss S
source:
Takuya is always positive, but takes time to make the first step since he is too cautious and thinks too much. Entering his second year, he decides to try to get a girlfriend and becomes closer to his classmates Hana and Yuu.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/02/28/february-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
拓也总是积极乐观，却因为过于谨慎、想得太多，迟迟难以迈出第一步。升上二年级后，他决心试着交个女朋友，并与同班的花菜和悠逐渐亲近起来。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/02/28/february-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
